about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the DEPLOYED page for #895 at build aa872f9, which re-keys the eight rows this branch committed at 058c31f. Main moved two of the four blobs the bind hashes while that pass was in review: #894 (5d2d65b) put an airborne eye in js/40_render.js and #893 (aa872f9) put a jump predicate in js/20_level.js. Neither draws a pixel in a still - one applies only while the feet are off the ground, the other only when the player presses a face and a ledge - and the frame hashes say so: at the four dealt seats flatparity hashes the identical frame at 058c31f and aa872f9. So this is a bind re-key, not a picture change, and the four dealt layout signatures are the ones the replaced rows already named. Route: `node tools/livecap.js frames --url <deployed ?dev=1&seed=60&boot=0> --vp 1440x763`, one page load and one boot per pose, DEV.freeze(true), DEV.set("grain",0), DEV.clear() before the pose, shutter from the canvas after DEV.tick; the pose table is checked into tools/livecap.js (FRAMES). Chromium handed back RGBA and the frame was re-encoded to colour type 2 through tools/png_rgb.js (rgb-diff 0, alpha min 255). The layout signature was read off the page that drew the frame; the audio term was NOT readable in this pass's headless loads (no output device, so SND.init's AudioContext constructor returns without setting SND.ac and js/50_ui_input.js never reaches a sample rate). It is therefore carried from the row this one supersedes and stated as carried, and the control for it is #404's own rule read the other way: that term changes how many draws precede generation, and all three signatures came back identical to the replaced rows' at the same seed, so the instrument that dealt these rooms is the one those rows name. Replaces the frame committed on this branch at 15a14f5 (bound 058c31f); the delta the captions quote is still measured against the frame the deployed front page carries (82e43cc), which is what a reader of this page is comparing against.
